fields.description: Issue features strong editorial commentary on Florida politics and Gov. Fuller Warren, including criticism of the press and discussion of the new Florida sales tax and its effects on merchants and consumers. Reports on a deep test oil well being drilled south west of Coral Gables and anticipates potential oil production in Dade County. Covers Miami Beach civic and law-enforcement matters including a death following detention and transfer to the Miami Retreat, discussion of gambling/lottery activity on Lincoln Road, and local court and policing items; includes entertainment and nightlife notices and other local commentary.
